instruction: Speak in French. Perform this monologue by starting softly and increasing your volume throughout, ending in a powerful, loud voice.
text: Au début, ce n'était qu'un murmure dans le vent, une idée fragile, mais maintenant c'est un cri, une tempête, une force que rien ne pourra arrêter !

target_values.volume: begin by speaking quietly, then build up to a very loud volume by the end

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The speaker maintains a relatively constant, normal-to-loud volume throughout the monologue. The requested progression from a soft start to a powerful, loud finish is completely absent.

instruction_evidence.soft_start: The beginning ('Au début...') is delivered at a normal volume, failing to start softly as instructed.
instruction_evidence.volume_progression: There is no audible buildup in volume; the intensity remains flat and static until the end.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: Not evaluated due to low instruction-following level.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: Not evaluated due to low instruction-following level.

instruction: Speak in French. Your performance should move from thoughtful (slow, normal pitch) to worried (faster, higher pitch), and finally to fearful (very fast, high pitch).
text: Je ne retrouve plus mon portefeuille, je l'avais il y a une minute... J'espère vraiment que je ne l'ai pas perdu dans la rue... Mon Dieu, mon passeport était dedans !

target_values.progression: Start thoughtful (slow, normal pitch), then become worried (faster, higher pitch), and end fearful (very fast, high pitch).

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The first two stages (thoughtful to worried) are executed reasonably well, but the final fearful stage contradicts the specific instruction to be 'very fast, high pitch', as it slows down and drops in pitch instead.

instruction_evidence.thoughtful: The first sentence is delivered at a slow pace with normal pitch as requested.
instruction_evidence.worried: The second sentence increases in speed and pitch slightly.
instruction_evidence.fearful: The final sentence fails to follow the instruction; it becomes slower and lower in pitch (breathy/dramatic) rather than very fast and high-pitched.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: Not applicable due to instruction-following score.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: Not applicable due to instruction-following score.

instruction: Speak in French. At a constant slow speed, begin speaking as if you are lost in thought, and then let a warm, happy feeling enter your voice as you continue.
text: On se demande parfois si on a fait les bons choix dans la vie... et puis on regarde ses enfants jouer et on sait que chaque moment en valait la peine.

target_values.speed: maintain a constant slow speed throughout

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio successfully maintains a constant slow speaking rate while distinctly shifting from a reflective, thoughtful tone to a warmer, happier emotion as requested.

instruction_evidence.speed: The pacing is unhurried and remains consistently slow throughout the entire utterance.
instruction_evidence.emotion_transition: The first half is delivered with a contemplative, 'lost in thought' tone, which smoothly transitions into a tender, warmer, and happier voice in the second half.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice sounds human-like with natural phrasing and appropriate pauses.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The emotional transition is subtle but effectively conveys the intended warmth and reflection.

instruction: Speak in French. Deliver this line with two opposing dynamic changes: your pitch should go up, and your volume should go down.
text: C'était comme un cri puissant qui s'est transformé en un murmure strident, s'étirant vers le silence tout en devenant plus perçant.

target_values.pitch: gradually rise from low to high
target_values.volume: simultaneously fade from loud to quiet

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio clearly and accurately realizes the requested opposing dynamic changes, progressively increasing pitch while simultaneously decreasing volume.

instruction_evidence.pitch: The speaker starts with a low vocal register and gradually rises to a notably higher pitch by the end of the sentence.
instruction_evidence.volume: The speech begins with a strong, louder delivery and progressively fades into a quiet, breathy murmur.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice sounds smooth, human-like, and natural, exhibiting no synthetic artifacts despite the complex dynamic constraints.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The contrasting dynamics are executed with excellent control and perfectly match the semantic progression of the text.

instruction: Speak in French. As you read this, simultaneously increase your speed from slow to fast and your volume from soft to very loud.
text: La voiture approchait lentement du virage, puis elle a accéléré, de plus en plus vite, jusqu'à franchir la ligne d'arrivée en tête sous les acclamations de la foule !

instruction_evidence.speed: Starts at a moderate-fast pace rather than slow, with only a slight acceleration towards the end.
instruction_evidence.volume: Starts at a normal-loud volume rather than soft, and remains mostly constant throughout the delivery.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: Not evaluated due to low instruction-following score.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: Not evaluated due to low instruction-following score.

instruction: Speak in French. Read this list starting at your normal pitch, let your pitch rise high in the middle, and then bring it back down to normal for the end.
text: Pour ce projet, nous aurons besoin de plusieurs choses : du papier, des ciseaux, de la colle forte, des marqueurs de toutes les couleurs, et enfin, un peu de patience.

target_values.pitch: start with a normal pitch, raise it to high in the middle, and then return to a normal pitch at the end

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio correctly follows the dynamic pitch instruction, starting normal, rising significantly in the middle, and dropping back to normal at the end. However, the delivery is heavily disjointed and robotic, preventing any bonus points.

instruction_evidence.pitch_start: The reading begins at a normal, baseline pitch.
instruction_evidence.pitch_middle: The pitch noticeably rises to a high level during the middle items ('de la colle forte, des marqueurs de toutes les couleurs').
instruction_evidence.pitch_end: The pitch drops back down to the baseline level for the final phrase ('et enfin, un peu de patience').

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The speech is very disjointed with unnatural, robotic pauses between almost every phrase.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: While the pitch changes as requested, the stilted and fragmented delivery ruins the overall expressive flow.

instruction: Speak in French. Begin at a moderate speaking rate, then continuously accelerate your pace throughout the sentence.
text: Pour comprendre l'histoire de l'art moderne, il faut d'abord examiner les mouvements artistiques du dix-neuvième siècle qui ont ouvert la voie à de nouvelles formes d'expression.

target_values.speed: start at a normal pace and gradually accelerate to a fast speed

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio begins at a moderate pace and increases slightly after the first clause, but the pace then plateaus, failing to demonstrate the requested continuous acceleration throughout the entire sentence.

instruction_evidence.start_pace: The audio correctly starts at a moderate speaking rate.
instruction_evidence.continuous_acceleration: The speed increases slightly in the middle but fails to continue accelerating towards the end, resulting in a flattened progression.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: Not evaluated due to instruction-following level < 3.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: Not evaluated due to instruction-following level < 3.

instruction: Speak in French. Deliver the first part with a detached, sarcastic tone. Then, let that sarcasm give way to real anger, making your voice firm and direct.
text: Ah, te voilà avec la réponse à tout. Je devrais peut-être prendre des notes pour la prochaine fois. Mais tu sais quoi ? J'en ai marre de ce petit jeu ! Ce n'est pas drôle, et les conséquences sont réelles. Il est temps que tu ouvres les yeux !

target_values.progression: Start with a sarcastic tone while emotionally neutral. Then, transition into genuine anger with a firm tone.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The dynamic progression is absent. The delivery is consistently slow, flat, and disjointed. There is no clear sarcasm at the beginning, and no transition to genuine, firm anger in the second half.

instruction_evidence.detached_sarcastic: The beginning sounds slow and slightly flat, rather than distinctly detached or sarcastic.
instruction_evidence.transition_to_anger: The second half fails to convey any real anger or firmness; the speaker maintains the same slow, disconnected, and unemotional pacing.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The speech sounds highly disjointed and robotic with unnatural pauses.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The delivery is flat and lacks both the sarcastic edge and the angry intensity requested.

instruction: Speak in French. Perform a transition of tone: from uncaring to pleading, and then from pleading to resigned disappointment.
text: Vous pouvez choisir n'importe laquelle des options, ça ne change rien. Mais ne voyez-vous pas que celle-ci est la seule qui peut nous sauver ? D'accord, alors. Il n'y a plus rien à dire.

target_values.tone: begin with an indifferent tone, then shift to a pleading one, and finish with a disappointed tone

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The temporal progression of tones is present but weak and flattened. The 'pleading' tone lacks emotional urgency, and the overall delivery is somewhat monotonous.

instruction_evidence.uncaring: The beginning is delivered flatly, which works for an uncaring tone.
instruction_evidence.pleading: There is a slight upward pitch variation in the middle, but it lacks the necessary emotional depth and urgency to sound truly pleading.
instruction_evidence.resigned disappointment: The final sentence drops in energy and pitch, successfully hinting at resignation, though still remaining somewhat stiff.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The speech sounds somewhat robotic and stiff.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The emotional transitions are too subtle, flattened, and lack dynamic range.
